label: NON-CANON PREVIEW
headline: Y'all Keep Confusing Loud With Right
deck: This ain't an O.W.L. result and it ain't canon. This is a private production preview used to test Sunday Disservice before the real sermons begin.

argument.title: Having a hot take don't mean you made a good argument
body: See, this is what I'm talkin' about. Folks hear somebody say something with enough confidence and suddenly we supposed to act like confidence is evidence. Nah. If your argument falls apart the second somebody asks one follow-up question, you ain't cookin'. You just made noise.

And I know somebody already mad at how I said it. That's fine. Be mad. But don't get so caught up in the delivery that you miss the point. I'm not here to make every opinion comfortable. I'm here to tell you what I think, tell you why I think it, and stand on it until somebody gives me a reason not to.

That's what Sunday Disservice is supposed to be. We can laugh, argue, call somebody out, give somebody their credit, and come back next week with receipts. Just don't expect me to nod along because everybody else decided something was true.

praise.title: Credit where it's due
praise.body: If somebody shows out, I'm gonna say they showed out. I can dislike the decision and still respect the performance. Both things can be true.

condemnation.title: Stop moving the goalposts
condemnation.body: What I can't stand is changing the argument every time the first one stops working. Pick a lane and defend it.

favorites.title: Yeah, I got favorites
favorites.body: Everybody got people they believe in a little more than everybody else. At least I'm not pretending I don't.

blindSpots.title: And y'all keep receipts
blindSpots.body: If I miss, call it out. Just make sure you remember when I was right too, because somehow those receipts always disappear.

closingWord: Test or no test, the rule stays the same. Bring an argument, bring receipts, and don't expect me to agree just because everybody else does.
